Overview.Name: Abhilash Gundlapally
Overview.Goal: Healthy weight gain, better appearance, increased energy, confidence, and stress reduction.

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat milk (250 ml)
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + 2 boiled eggs + banana (100 g)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat curd (150 g)
Breakfast: Option 1: Omelette (3 eggs) with vegetables (50 g) + rice poha (100 g) + milk (200 ml)
Option 2: Boiled eggs (3) + rice rawa upma (100 g) + curd (150 g)
Option 3: Paneer curry (150 g) + rice (100 g) + milk (200 ml)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (200 g) + chicken curry (200 g) + dal (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (150 g)
Option 2: Plain rice (200 g) + egg curry (3 eggs) + dal (150 g) + vegetables (100 g) + curd (150 g)
Option 3: Plain rice (200 g) + paneer curry (200 g) + dal (150 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (150 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice (40 g) with peanuts (20 g) + banana (100 g) + milk (200 ml)
Option 2: Boiled chickpeas (80 g) with vegetables (50 g) + fruit (100 g)
Option 3: Full fat curd (150 g) + fruit (100 g) + handful peanuts (20 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Chicken curry (200 g) + rice (150 g) + dal (100 g) + vegetables (100 g) + curd (150 g)
Option 2: Egg curry (3 eggs) + rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + milk (200 ml)
Option 3: Paneer curry (200 g) + rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + vegetables (100 g) + curd (150 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Focus on completing full meals consistently; aim for steady, small increases if appetite is low.
Use rice and full-fat dairy daily to support healthy weight gain.
Include eggs, paneer, and dal across the week for protein.
For cravings: prefer fruit, jaggery in milk, or puffed rice instead of processed sweets.
Keep ready-to-eat healthy snacks (puffed rice, boiled chickpeas) for boredom or late work.
Eat slowly and keep evening snack to bridge lunch and dinner for steady intake.
